Create HTTP/80 LB with origin; reload and inspect persisted configuration
Actions -> Manage Configuration -> Edit Configuration -> WAF Enable -> shared/base-appfw -> Save -> reload
Nested origin Weight/Priority edits are discarded by Discard
Origin selection Apply persists Weight 2 / Priority 3 after parent Save and reload
View Configuration opens the selected Origin Pool and returns to the connection draft
Reset confirmation Keep editing leaves the draft intact
Reset to Defaults preserves name/domain/ID/counters, clears origin/WAF and resets HTTPS/443/default configuration
Cancel after reset followed by reload retains the saved HTTP/80/DNS/WAF configuration
Reset All Fields restores the opened origin and WAF configuration
Reset settings can be saved after reselecting an origin; reload confirms HTTPS/443, WAF disabled, DNS false
HTTP/80/DNS/shared WAF can be re-enabled and saved after reset
Cancel new cancelled-lab1-lb creation leaves only the saved LB after reload
Origin edit/remove icons are visible and clickable; Remove changes only the draft and Reset All Fields restores the reference

Normal request returns 200; SQL Injection, XSS and Command Injection return 403 and produce three security events
624px and 1280px forms have no document overflow and keep the footer at the viewport bottom
